releases.name: v0.21.8 — Quieter quota scale tracks
releases.body:
## Highlights

- Make the unfilled portion of Limits scales much quieter, using the same theme-derived tone as sidebar section dividers.
- Retain the normal muted tone for the filled portion and readable reset/remaining details.
- Apply the contrast treatment in both Nerd Font and Text fallback modes, including after theme changes.

## Upgrade notes

- Update Navigator through your existing installation method and restart OpenCode.
- Quota layout, controls, banked-reset confirmations, native units, and the configured refresh interval retain their established behavior. Automatic refresh still defaults to five minutes with a one-minute minimum.
- Recognized pinned snapshots retain their local source and scope. Publishing this release does not switch a locally installed snapshot automatically.
- Rounded multiline selections still require the OpenCode Navigator Corners font on the machine displaying the terminal; fully restart the terminal after installing or updating the font.

[Versioned changelog](https://github.com/St1ggy/opencode-navigator/blob/v0.21.8/CHANGELOG.md).

releases.name: v0.21.7 — Guide-free Limits
releases.body:
## Highlights

- Remove the vertical guide from Limits in both Nerd Font and Text fallback modes.
- Remove the guide gutter too, letting quota scales use the full sidebar content width.
- Keep a single blank row between windows and retain the details row with reset time on the left and remaining allowance on the right.

## Upgrade notes

- Update Navigator through your existing installation method and restart OpenCode.
- Model/variant controls, Refresh, Banked Resets, native quota units, and the configured refresh interval retain their established behavior. Automatic refresh still defaults to five minutes with a one-minute minimum.
- Recognized pinned snapshots retain their local source and scope. Publishing this release does not switch a locally installed snapshot automatically.
- Rounded multiline selections still require the OpenCode Navigator Corners font on the machine displaying the terminal; fully restart the terminal after installing or updating the font.

[Versioned changelog](https://github.com/St1ggy/opencode-navigator/blob/v0.21.7/CHANGELOG.md).

releases.name: v0.21.6 — Connected quota scales
releases.body:
## Highlights

- Limits now joins quota windows with a continuous muted vertical guide and a single guide-only row between windows.
- Each window has a full-width thin-line scale above one details row: reset time on the left, remaining allowance aligned to the right.
- Long reset text is clipped without overlapping the reserved remaining value. Quota rows stay inside narrow or padded sidebars and adapt after resize.
- Text fallback uses an ASCII `|` guide and `=`/`-` scales. Provider-native units and unknown-scale guidance are retained.

## Upgrade notes

- Update Navigator through your existing installation method and restart OpenCode.
- Model and variant selection, header Refresh, Banked Resets, account bindings, and reset-credit confirmations keep their established behavior. The configured automatic refresh interval remains respected; its default is still five minutes.
- OpenCode 1.x pre-submission model selection remains API-limited through 1.18.35; OpenCode 2 follows the public reactive prompt-model API.
- Recognized pinned snapshots retain their local source and scope. This release does not switch a locally installed snapshot automatically.
- Rounded multiline selections still require the OpenCode Navigator Corners font on the machine displaying the terminal; fully restart the terminal after installing or updating the font.

[Versioned changelog](https://github.com/St1ggy/opencode-navigator/blob/v0.21.6/CHANGELOG.md).

releases.name: v0.21.5 — Configurable Limits refresh
releases.body:
## Highlights

- Automatic Limits refresh now defaults to five minutes. Set a different whole-minute interval under **Settings → Behavior → Limits refresh interval**, with a minimum of one minute.
- Save the interval independently for Global or Current worktree scope, or configure `behavior.limitsRefreshMinutes` through the plugin options, user settings file, or project settings file. The legacy `limits_refresh_minutes` option is also supported.
- Changing the effective interval reschedules polling without an extra quota request. Unrelated preference changes and unchanged provider-account metadata observations no longer trigger quota polling.
- Manual Refresh and supported model/account switches remain immediate. OpenCode 2 follows the prompt's selected model before a message is sent.

## Upgrade notes

- Update Navigator through your existing installation method and restart OpenCode. Existing preferences inherit the five-minute default unless an interval is configured or saved.
- **OpenCode 1.x limitation:** versions through 1.18.35 expose only the saved session model. A newly selected prompt model reaches Navigator when the host saves it, normally on message submission. Immediate pre-submission switching in 1.x still needs a public host accessor or event; this release does not claim to remove that limitation.
- Recognized pinned snapshots retain their local source and scope. Publishing this release does not switch a locally installed snapshot automatically.
- Rounded multiline highlights still require the OpenCode Navigator Corners font on the machine displaying the terminal; fully restart the terminal after installing or updating the font.

[Versioned changelog](https://github.com/St1ggy/opencode-navigator/blob/v0.21.5/CHANGELOG.md).

releases.name: v0.21.4 — Navigator update shortcuts
releases.body:
## Highlights

- Press the configured Navigator shortcut (default `Ctrl+Shift+B`), then `c` to check for a Navigator update or `u` to check and open its confirmation. Both actions are also available in the command palette.
- Manual checks report an available update, a current installation, or an unavailable update source. Stalled checks time out and can be retried; background failures remain quiet.
- Cancelled, outdated, and repeated update confirmations are ignored. Updates preserve the current installation method and scope and show a restart reminder after completion.
- Shortcut-mode hints list only actions supported by the current OpenCode host.

## Upgrade notes

- Update Navigator through its existing version control or your current installation method, then restart OpenCode. The new `c` and `u` shortcuts become available after loading this release.
- Recognized pinned local snapshots retain their existing file or directory source. The release does not change locally installed snapshots or client settings automatically.
- OpenCode 1.x and 2.x remain supported. Rounded multiline selections require the OpenCode Navigator Corners font on the machine displaying the terminal; fully restart the terminal after installing or updating that font.

[Versioned changelog](https://github.com/St1ggy/opencode-navigator/blob/v0.21.4/CHANGELOG.md).
